description: The organizational mission is not understood to inform cybersecurity risk management.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of documented organizational mission statements that connect to cybersecurity strategy, missing alignment between business objectives and security priorities, lack of documented understanding of how cybersecurity supports organizational goals.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
